query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='openfoodfoundation/openfoodnetwork' AND number=2338 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Email confirmation | Enabling hub manager to identify guest customers lines
data.body:
## Description
Following conversation https://github.com/openfoodfoundation/openfoodnetwork/issues/1592#issuecomment-392276084
The problem is that when a guest customer creates a verified accounts, they appear twice in the customer list of the shop. One entry is the recort corresponding to guest previous orders, the other corresponds to the new account.
To avoid confusion from hub manager we want to make clear which entry correspond to the guest one.

## Expected Behavior
Hub manager cleary see which entry is the guest customer through a label displayed on the customer line.
![screenshot from 2018-05-27 18-30-42](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8135376/40588322-19ac579c-61dc-11e8-82c8-e259e1cb1e9b.png)

## Actual Behavior
No identification.

## Context
Finishing email confirmation project.

## Possible Fix
Add a "guest" label in the UI. The suggestion above is just a suggestion, if you have a better idea please submit it.
